文化軽視の政治いつまで　「日本美術館」は不要ですか

日本の貴重な名品が続々と海外に流出しています。

近年は日本カルチャーへの関心の高まりと円安の進行が重なり、海外勢にとって国内の美術品は絶好の「買い場」に。

日本が文化立国をめざすのであれば、短期の視点ではなく、国際競争に勝つ戦略を考える必要がありそうです。

The blue-footed booby (Sula nebouxii) is a marine bird native to subtropical and tropical regions of the eastern Pacific Ocean.

Its most notable characteristic is its blue-colored feet, which can range in color from a pale turquoise to a deep aquamarine.

item.description: During the Great Depression, Douglass Crockwell made several paintings for the Works Progress Administration including this work from 1932, which celebrates the industrial workers at the newspaper plant in the town of Glens Falls, New York.
